prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vibrant, hyper-realistic product shot of a breakfast cereal box placed on a light wooden table against a smooth, gradient blue background. The cereal box is prominently branded with the name "Civitai" and features a bold, geometric logo in white and blue, reminiscent of tech or blockchain aesthetics. The front of the box displays a large, inviting image of a white bowl filled with colorful, ring-shaped cereal pieces—reds, yellows, greens, blues—overflowing slightly, with a few pieces scattered on the table in the foreground for a playful touch. Behind the bowl, stylized black server racks rise up, adding a whimsical, tech-inspired twist to the scene. A speech bubble on the box reads, "FREE blue buzz in every box!" The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows and giving the scene a clean, modern look. A shiny metal spoon lies beside the box, reflecting the colors of the cereal. The overall composition is crisp and commercial, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the box and bowl, while the background remains softly blurred. The color palette is dominated by cool blues, punctuated by the vivid, saturated hues of the cereal, creating a cheerful and contemporary mood.
